note: Station 2, the Weave-Step (PLAN.md section 7; built 2026-11-11 at the plan's site, 1575,1163: PLAN.md 7b). The monocline's ramp falls east from the Cradle's fans to the chasms: the model draws it 1,740 m at the page's west edge, 1,479 m at the site, 1,236 m at the east edge, and a box canyon opening east-south-east past the page (993 m 6 km out, 723 m 14 km). kin: the Great Chasm's kit for the cold-desert ground cover (BSk, 125 mm), as on the Loom. The site record below is the plan's data, corrected (atm); build.py reads only kin, core and base.
name: The Weave-Step (station 2): the monocline's stepped basalt benches with box canyons cut into them, talus skirting the risers, a fortified Yuni waystation with windbreak palisades on the road down to the chasms
